variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
